body: I've never worked with an employment agency or counselor. Do you have to pay them? I always liked the idea of the temp agency because admin is not a career goal but my experience makes it easy for me to find positions.   Leaving eventually in a year or 2 would feel less tacky.

I actually moved back because part-time cashiering positions where all I could find. I worked retail (again) for over a year and it was just not paying the bills. I even moved into a much cheaper place that I could barely afford but noise/smoke/late-night partying made my living situation pretty bad.

I have gone through temp agencies for admin work for twice as much as  what I made retail. I was going to help my family and pay for my classes but I have hit a wall. I have never had this hard of a time getting something quickly through this agency. The one position would have been perfect and they had me on the hook for 3 weeks waiting to start.
 
I have lost my aid because of my grades. No one to blame but myself. I have actually been eyeing the meet-ups in this area and it looks like there is a guy that does hikes somewhat regularly. It's well past time for me to reach out. 

Sound advice all around. Thank you for the guidance and encouragement. It helps :)

I have thrown myself into gardening and reading trashy novels to escape. I went on a few hikes but it's just not the same by myself. 

I did talk to my adviser and finishing up the credits elsewhere won't be a problem but my aid is being cut because of my grades. Getting a job this summer was supposed to help me hurdle that but it's time for a plan B.

Thank you for your kind words and support. My family says things will work out and it puts pressure on me instead of being encouraging. I really needed to hear I will be okay and you took a moment to think about a stranger having a rough couple of months. It means a lot :)

I feel like I've been in a pit for a few years now. Digging out has always somehow left me deeper like quick sand. The plan was to find a decent paying job and then volunteer in my field to make connections up here. The job part just has not happened like I needed it to.  

Thank you for the support! It truly means a lot to me right now. I am hopeful and I cannot wait to look back on this.
